g.aria-label: X-axis titled 'Population' for a linear scale with values from −100,000 to 250,000
Y-axis titled 'Age group' for a discrete scale with 17 values: 0 - 4, 5 - 9, 10 - 14, 15 - 19, 20 - 24, ending with +80
Symbol legend titled 'Period' for fill color with 2 values: 2024 (actual), 2040 (Base)
